algorithm_policy: Production math, quotas and recovery algorithms unchanged; only recorded sanitization, recipient-backfill/test omission and optional renderer import/API adaptations.

exclusions.default_deny: Every tracked path not in ALLOWLIST is excluded; untracked files and Git history are never read for export.
exclusions.reference_limitations: reference/ is review-only, not a runnable deployment: provider configuration, private inputs, staging helpers, news/map assets and credentials are intentionally absent. scripts/render_chamber_map.py is optional source requiring Pillow and omitted geographic assets, never needed by the offline demo. Generic public provider API addresses and OAuth scope URIs remain as architectural evidence; deployed project endpoints and authority identifiers are sanitized.
exclusions.test_policy: Only the eight listed dependency-light behavioral test modules; omit source-text/production wiring/cloud tests, production conftest, maps and external fixtures. One map-rendering test is removed from the retained board-export module.

ownership_policy: Exporter never overwrites differing files, including prior owned exports; sibling docs/demo remain untouched.
release_kind: production-derived source snapshot plus separately authored offline demonstration; not a deployment
source_manifest_scope: Only source export and listed generated configuration; separately authored demo/docs/security/CI are not source-derived exports.
